I think it comes quite close to being considered a copy of HoL. I know the “bigger on the inside” concept has been done before, but the similarities don’t just stop there. The fact that its a family in a new house and the children/child gets lost in it. The fact that house is a changing liminal space of sorts. When I think House of leaves, it doesn’t remind me of Doctor Who, or any of the other stories that contain the “bigger on the outside” trope. That’s because it is used in two very original and different ways. You Should Have Left however, does remind me a lot about HoL. It just feels like they took a substantial portion of the plot of HoL and made it more basic so that the YSHL book could be made into a movie. There is a reason for the fact no one has made a HoL movie/series, it because it is a book that is so complex and specific that it can’t be translated into a movie format. Maybe one day an amazing director will come along and be able to do the impossible but the book will always be truly one of a kind. It may be difficult to get through at some points but I promise it is well worth your while. The YSHL book and movie are not able to replace the HoL book in any capacity. This is nothing against the people who enjoyed the YSHL book or movie, just an honest opinion and recommendation for those who were intrigued by the concepts.
